description: This file defines a PHP trait 'SqlFieldableEntityTypeListenerTrait' that provides methods for handling updates to entity types in Drupal, including schema validation, data copying, and cleanup during entity schema updates.

methods.name: onFieldableEntityTypeUpdate
methods.description: Handles the update process for a fieldable entity type, including schema validation, data copying, and post-update cleanup.

methods.name: preUpdateEntityTypeSchema
methods.description: Hook for subscribers to prepare schema before data copying.

methods.name: postUpdateEntityTypeSchema
methods.description: Hook for subscribers to perform cleanup after data copying.

methods.name: copyData
methods.description: Copies entity data from the original storage to a temporary storage during schema updates.

methods.name: handleEntityTypeSchemaUpdateExceptionOnDataCopy
methods.description: Handles exceptions that occur during data copying.
